name: memory-eternal
description: 记忆核心（Memory Eternal）：自研的 DeepSeek Harness 记忆插件，不移植任何既有记忆框架——对话结束后自动沉淀知识卡到本地 Markdown Vault（自研去重、自研 CJK 检索、可 git 管理），设置页提供图形化知识库（统计 / 搜索 / 知识图谱 + 侧边栏一键弹窗），Agent 通过 memory_recall 工具按需召回历史上下文。零人工干预。
author: EternalNight996

externalServices: Public RSS/Atom feeds: 量子位, 雷锋网, 钛媒体, InfoQ 中文, TechCrunch AI, The Verge AI, MIT Technology Review AI, Google DeepMind
Hacker News Algolia API (AI story ranking)
User-configured embedding endpoint for optional semantic recall (default http://127.0.0.1:7997/v1; disabled unless enabled in Settings → Memory)
permissions.notes: Read/write under ~/.dsh/memory-vault only. Memory data stays local; only the optional News page fetches the fixed public RSS/HN sources above on demand (titles, excerpts, links). No credentials, no shell. Hooks/MCP run via the `node` binary that hosts the DSH process.

lifecycle.notes: Only `prepare` and `prepublishOnly` run `node build.mjs` (esbuild client bundling). No preinstall/install/postinstall hooks, no remote downloads, no native builds.
